node.create.label: Create layer
node.create.params: {type: rectangle|ellipse|polygon|star|line|arrow|vector|text|frame|section|component|slice, x?, y? (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width?, height?, parent? (id; default: the page), index?, name?, text? (for text), path? (SVG path data for vector), props? {node.set keys}, select? (default true)}

export.add.label: Add export setting
export.add.params: {ids?, setting? {size: 2x|512w|512h|{by: scale|width|height, value}, suffix?, format?: png|jpg|svg|pdf|webp, bleed? (PDF: points, or with a unit: "3mm", "0.125in", "9pt"), cropMarks?, bleedMarks?, cmyk? (PDF print options)}} (without a setting: 1x, then one scale step up with an "@2x"-style suffix)

inspect.properties.label: Inspect properties
inspect.properties.params: {id?, colorFormat?: hex|rgb|css|hsl|hsb (default hex)} → {sections: [{title, rows: [{label, value, color?, token?}]}]}  layout (positions from the frame around the layer), auto layout, typography, fills, strokes and effects, with style and variable names

inspect.code.label: Code for layer
inspect.code.params: {id?, language?: css|html|react|leptos|swiftui|compose (default css; html, react and leptos are the whole layer tree; components take their properties as parameters, instances pass their values; a component connected to code (codeConnect.set) gives its import and snippet instead), unit?: px|rem (CSS, HTML, React and Leptos; default px), rootFontSize? (rem: pixels per rem, default 16)} → {code, language, connected}

inspect.assets.label: Inspect assets
inspect.assets.params: {ids? (default the selection)} → {assets: [{id, name, kind: export|icon|image, exports}]}  the layers in and under them to hand over as files: those with export settings, icons (small, vector shapes only; SVG) and images (PNG). Export them with `file.exportLayers {assets: true}`

file.exportLayers.label: Export layers
file.exportLayers.params: {ids? (default the selection, else every layer on the page with export settings), assets? (true: the Inspect tab's assets in and under them instead: layers with export settings, icons as SVG, images as PNG), dir? (folder to write into; else each file comes back as base64 `data`), bleed? (PDF: points, or with a unit: "3mm", "0.125in", "9pt"), cropMarks?, bleedMarks?, cmyk? (PDF print options): for every PDF instead of each setting's own}  every layer once per export setting, named `<layer><suffix>.<format>` ("@2x" when a scaled export has no suffix; repeats get " 2"; slashes in a layer name make folders). Returns {files: [{name, id, bytes, path | data}], skipped (layers without settings)}
